description: Carnot-based COP with AMR efficiency, temperature correction, and part-load penalty

unit.name: Near-room-temperature AMR (Gadolinium-based, 10 kW cooling)
unit.source: Kitanovski et al. (2015), Magnetocaloric Energy Conversion; Yu et al. (2010), Int. J. Refrig. 33(6)

eta_AMR.note: AMR system COP relative to Carnot (magnet + regen + cycle losses)

plr_p3.note: Part-load curve: f_PLR = p1+p2*PLR+p3*PLR^2; at PLR=1: f=1.0; quadratic peaks near 1

delta_T_span.note: Practical AMR span; wider spans reduce COP significantly
